title: Build broken on non-x86_64
body:
Building from commit https://github.com/yandex/odyssey/commit/e3445998d9d3dec8e46075bcf7ad9ded9f880162 became broken on other arches then x86_64.

Building from commit 60b9f9f6d9ab52b7cc3df1c7ebed9d36e35e5413 was OK on all arches.

Build error on **aarch64**:

```
DEBUG: /builddir/build/BUILD/odyssey-e3445998d9d3dec8e46075bcf7ad9ded9f880162/build/third_party/machinarium/sources/context.c: In function 'mm_context_prepare':
DEBUG: /builddir/build/BUILD/odyssey-e3445998d9d3dec8e46075bcf7ad9ded9f880162/build/third_party/machinarium/sources/context.c:52:21: error: ISO C forbids conversion of function pointer to object pointer type [-Werror=pedantic]
DEBUG:    52 |         *(sp + 1) = (void *)mm_context_runner;
DEBUG:       |                     ^
DEBUG: cc1: all warnings being treated as errors
```
Full build log on aarch64: https://abf.io/build_lists/5443986 -> script_output.log

On loongarch64:
```
DEBUG: CMake Error at sources/CMakeLists.txt:60 (message):
DEBUG:   Unsupported architecture: loongarch64
```
(not a regression)
loongarch64: https://abf.io/build_lists/5443988

On i686 (32 bit x86):
```
DEBUG: /builddir/build/BUILD/odyssey-e3445998d9d3dec8e46075bcf7ad9ded9f880162/build/third_party/machinarium/sources/context.c:55:17: error: ISO C forbids conversion of function pointer to object pointer type [-Werror=pedantic]
DEBUG:    55 |         *--sp = (void *)mm_context_runner;
DEBUG:       |                 ^
```
and warnings like:
```
DEBUG: /builddir/build/BUILD/odyssey-e3445998d9d3dec8e46075bcf7ad9ded9f880162/build/third_party/machinarium/sources/wait_group.h:13:1: note: the alignment of '_Atomic long long unsigned int' fields changed in GCC 11.1
DEBUG:    13 | } mm_wait_group_t;
DEBUG:       | ^
```
I think nobody uses odyssey on 32 bit, so I think it is not a problem.
i686: https://abf.io/build_lists/5443082

body: Instead of returning an error code directly, we should return -1 and use mm_errno_set.

title: use return codes from errno.h in wait_list and wait_group
body: The errno.h return codes are already used in the code as an event.call.status. It makes sense to use them in wait_list and wait_group also.

title: rewrite wait_group (use compare_wait, change done behaviour)
body:
1. Use the wait_list's compare-and-wait functionality in the wait_group implementation. That fixes the potential presence of lost wake-ups.
2. Abort if mm_wait_group_done was called when a wait_group had a zero counter.
3. Add timeout test.

title: rewrite wait list (notify_all, sleepy release)
body:
1. The current implementation of mm_wait_list is non-linearizable because the mm_wait_list_notify_all function is not atomic with respect to other wait_list operations. This makes a wait list an extremely hard structure to reason about. It also makes the guarantees that a wait_list provides very unclear. This proposal changes the notify_all implementation, thus solving the problem.
2. The sleepy release optimization in mm_wait_list is hard to read. In a private discussion with @rkhapov, it was decided to remove it.
3. The sleepies_count field can be made non-atomic as it is used only when holding a wait_list's lock.

title: Fix potential NULL pointer dereference in auth.c
body:
The issue I'm addressing is a potential NULL pointer dereference in the `auth.c` file when accessing `client->received_password.password` or `client->password.password` without sufficient prior validation. In some cases, if `client == NULL` or those fields are not set, this can lead to undefined behavior or crashes during authentication flow.

This change ensures that all accesses to these fields are guarded by checks on `client` and its subfields before they're used. The logic has been simplified and centralized to avoid redundant NULL checks and make the code safer.
